summary: This round confirms THE Room at head 8467f01 against the confirmed head 1430d42. git diff 1430d42..HEAD -- cabin777/src cabin777/tex touches only 04_shaders.js, 12_scene.js and 4 lines of 07_shell.js. 09c_room.js, 09_seats.js, 03_tex.js and tex/ are unchanged. Every room-only calibration region is identical to within 1 L: q09 privacy wall L54.1, q06 near shell L62.4, q06 monitor-end door L167.3, q06 and q07 ash L152.9 and L161.5, q08 header band L102.2, q08 flap L109.5, q10 shell L62.3, and the q07 footwell L75.3 -> 75.7. The changed pixels are window and sidewall lighting: q07 37.8 % of the right half against 1.1 % of the left, and q08 25 % of the right against 7 % of the left. The two routed lighting items both improved. The q07 window-side post went from L73 to L98, against L111 in c_27316. The THE Room window wall is less cool: B-R went from +9..+20 to +6..+12 across the q06 and q08 sidewall boxes. Nothing regressed. There are no new artefacts on the post at 2x: the grain is unchanged and there are no seams or banding. The product still reads clearly as THE Room, with minor material and lighting differences. The open lows carried from the earlier rounds are unchanged.

Both routed lighting items moved toward the photos: the q07 post went L73 -> 98 against the photo's 111, and the window-wall B-R dropped by 3-8. Neither is enough to raise the room score, and nothing regressed. No high or medium issue is open for the room.
